blogs.title: Is the Transformer King? Meet xLSTM, the Modern Revival of a Classic
blogs.description: Explore how researchers are challenging the dominance of Transformers by breathing new life into the decades-old LSTM architecture. This post breaks down why LSTMs fell out of favor and how 'xLSTM' combines the best of old-school recurrent networks with modern scaling techniques to compete with today's largest AI models.

blogs.title: Beyond Scalar Memory: How Matrix Storage Supercharges AI Recall
blogs.description: Deep dive into the 'mLSTM' innovation: swapping traditional single-number memory cells for massive matrix memories. Learn how this shift mimics human associative recall, allowing AI to store and retrieve complex relationships (keys and values) much more effectively than previous generations of models.

blogs.title: The Secret Sauce of xLSTM: Exponential Gating and Stable Learning
blogs.description: Unpack the mathematical magic behind 'exponential gating.' This post explains how changing how the network decides what to remember or forget prevents errors from vanishing or exploding, giving xLSTM the stability needed to handle billion-parameter scales without crashing.

blogs.title: Speed vs. Power: Why xLSTM Might Be the Future of Edge AI
blogs.description: Compare the efficiency of xLSTM against Transformers. While Transformers struggle with long texts due to quadratic memory growth, xLSTM offers linear complexity and constant memory usage. Discover why this makes it a game-changer for running powerful AI on mobile devices and in real-time applications.

blogs.title: State Tracking Reborn: Solving Problems Transformers Can't Touch
blogs.description: Focus on the unique ability of xLSTM (specifically sLSTM) to perform 'memory mixing'—a feature that allows it to track state over time in ways that pure attention mechanisms often miss. See examples where xLSTM outperforms state-of-the-art models on logic puzzles, code evaluation, and complex sequence tasks.
